**Message failing integrity is discarded**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NAS / NAS security / Integrity protection of NAS signalling messages |
| Tags | negative, security |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 46s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration, PDU session establishment |

## Clauses

- TS 24.501 4.4.4.3 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-16: V16.3.0 splits the REGISTRATION REQUEST rule into initial and mobility registration; the discard paragraph is unchanged from V15.0.0 through V19.8.0; Rel-18: V18.0.0 adds the unsuccessful-authentication sentence to the REGISTRATION REQUEST rules; the discard paragraph is unchanged)
- TS 33.501 6.4.3.3 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NAS-INTEGRITY-FAIL-DISCARD.md).
